scientific_note: Multi-Pillar OriginTrace Synergy Contract: Bare domain lexical scoring is an auxiliary structural prior (operating at calibrated threshold tau=0.70, FPR <= 3.99% to prevent false positives on clean domains). High-confidence domain verdicts in OriginTrace are established through multi-modal synergy: ProvenanceMatrix (TLS cert lineage, lookalike detection), InfrastructureLineage (WHOIS age < 14d, Fast-Flux DNS, ASN brand incongruity), URL Specialist ML (99.9% ROC-AUC on root URLs), and live threat intelligence.
